incident.reported_context: PR #4667 retained strict byte equality by re-rendering legacy brief content from current bound config, but pre-fix briefs generated by older supervisor logic failed that strict comparison before any promotion mutation.
incident.boundary_reason: Historical legacy task briefs in the mutable incumbent may differ from current canonical re-rendering if generated under previous formats. The bootstrap transaction must verify their history-bounded provenance without broadening drift acceptance or relaxing cleanliness for non-legacy or untracked files.

decision.entrypoint: _verify_legacy_task_brief_provenance in scripts/promote_supervisor_runtime.py is invoked during legacy mutable incumbent drift capture.
provenance_checks: 1. Match against current canonical rendered digest (_render_canonical_task_brief_digest).

3. Candidate-tracked exact provenance verification: _is_historical_task_id_known checks authoritative candidate history only (expected_head:ai-status.json, candidate archives, expected_head:ai-activity-log.jsonl, git log of expected_head; NEVER disk status/archive), verifies candidate tracked path, and checks byte length and SHA256 against candidate-tracked historical commit blobs (_matches_candidate_tracked_provenance_blob) and CANDIDATE_TRACKED_LEGACY_TASK_BRIEF_PROVENANCE_BINDINGS.
